notes.title: Scope shared records to their owner
notes.guidance: Bind each record to its owner at creation. Enforce the same ownership check on lists, details, attachments and exports. Verify the fix using separate synthetic accounts that share a hostname or resource label.

notes.title: Bind a saved secret to its recipient
notes.guidance: Associate the credential with its approved destination. Require an explicit credential decision when the destination changes. If disclosure occurred, revoke the exposed secret and review the recipient’s access logs.
